_comment: Spire base shop catalogue (newserv guard v50, SpireMeta.hh; plan-basis-metawinkel-2026-10-26 slice 4, B-BASIS-2/-3/-13). Read at every 'M' request; a missing or broken file closes the shop. FIRST VERSION: every price and P is a placeholder until the balance is tuned; PNeeded comes from the sim (curve_spire.py pneeded) (route B F2: an average run earns about 50 splinters, see Payout).

start_level._what: Route B F3: Levels[n] start levels at level n (+5 for 50, +10 for 110 in total, +14 for 185 in total). Guard v52: the server sends each client the quest .bin with the rule block's ba_set_char_level raised by that many levels and builds its overlay at that level (quest load and run again 'I'). P 0 at every level (B-BASIS-67, route B invariant 7): bought start levels add no heat. B-AF-1 (spel-af): levels 4-9 (+18 ... +38, +4 each) open one per late boss, the first time the character beats it in a real run on any difficulty (Boss: the boss room k; meta.json BossesBeaten): Vol Opt k11, Dark Falz k15, Barba Ray k18, Gol Dragon k21, Gal Gryphon k27, Olga Flow k30 (spel-af item 5: the Central Control Area is k23-k26). Until then the level is listed with price 0 and refused as not on sale, with a ticker that names the boss.

kit_tier._what: level 1: the second kit of the class archetype (the quest's existing second-kit branch, Dagger/Rifle/Barta) from the first run. OnSale 1: level 2 has no kit yet.

hp_mat._what: 2 HP Materials per level in the start kit (each +2 max HP when used); 2 levels count 1 level equivalent.

atp_grind._what: 2 Monogrinders per level in the start kit (each +1 grind on the weapon when used); 1 level equivalent per level.

open_hard._what: BaseRung 1 (Hard) for Spire Run I and II (B-BASIS-13). PNeeded 8 is held on purpose: a recalibration of the sim does not move the threshold at which a rung opens (regie, 2026-11-11, balans 4). It was set as the end of the sim's meta-heat table (P 8) by the rule of pso-roguelike sim/curve_spire.py pneeded: the first P at which half the classes play Normal's top heat, the H at which the hardest Normal row reaches f 1.0. On the sim of balans 4 (pso-roguelike spike/balans d3b91e2: hardest Normal row f 0.80 + 0.05 H, top of Normal at H 4, uncapped H_auto 3-6 at P 8) that rule would give P 6.

open_vh._what: BaseRung 2 (Very Hard). PNeeded: the rule of open_hard on Hard's table (pso-roguelike sim/curve_spire.py pneeded) gives a P nobody can own: on the sim of balans 4 (pso-roguelike spike/balans d3b91e2) Hard's top is H 6 (its hardest row f 0.70 + 0.05 H reaches 1.0) and half the classes play H_auto >= 6 from P 32 (before balans 4: top H 8, P 29), but the most strength anyone can own is 9 (kit_tier 2 + hp_mat 2 + atp_grind 5), so such a P could never be bought while the refusal says more upgrades open it. Spoor beloningen B-BEL-3: P 9, everything bought, held on purpose through the recalibration (regie, 2026-11-11); it also needs Hard open (won or bought) and costs 120 splinters, so Very Hard can be bought without a win.

open_ult._what: BaseRung 3 (Ultimate). PNeeded: the same rule on Very Hard's table gives no P at all on the sim of balans 4 (pso-roguelike spike/balans d3b91e2): top H 4 (hardest row f 0.80), and no P of 0-40 brings half the classes to H_auto >= 4, every cell of P 0-16 being 0 (before balans 4: top H 5, from P 38, above the strength anyone can own, 9). B-BEL-3: P 9 as open_vh, held on purpose through the recalibration (regie, 2026-11-11); it also needs Very Hard open (won or bought) and costs 240 splinters, so all three rungs can be bought for 420 splinters without a win.

Payout._what: Route B F2: photon splinters per room. A room k pays PerRoom when its checkpoint is stored, a boss room PerBoss on top (a boss room counts as a room), once per run and k, kept in records.json Credited, so a freeze keeps what was paid. 'F' adds only the pact bonus floor(paid * pacts * PactTenths / 10), pacts 0-4 from 'F' bits 19-21. An average run (10 rooms, 2 bosses) pays 50, with 4 pacts 70. Without this block the server pays the old rooms + 5 per boss at 'F' and logs a warning.

MetaHeat._source: H_auto[class][P], P 0-8: pso-roguelike spike/balans d3b91e2 (balans 4: the sim calibrated on the level column the run plays), quests/spire/data/economy.json meta_heat.H_auto, from sim/curve_spire.py meta_heat_table (E08-diepte/sim meta_heat_for on sim/plan-spire.json, Normal's override rooms), with the Grass Assassin HTD floor 3 (ENEMY_HTD_FLOOR, variant I of B-BASIS-4), then capped (_cap). null = no H <= 20 keeps the band; the server then takes the last heat of the class at a lower P, and P past 8 takes the P 8 column. The quest data holds one override row set per H 0..6 (economy.json meta_heat.H_max, the highest uncapped H) and newserv writes the rows of the game's H into the .bin it sends (system/spire-heat/q<N>.json, at most its HeatMax). pso-roguelike quests/spire/check_meta_heat_sync.py (pc-build.sh) refuses a build whose economy files and these tables differ: after a new sim, derive the tables again by the rules here.
MetaHeat._cap: Route B F3 (B-BASIS-67): every HAuto (Normal) value is capped at 2, so HP stays at baseline (max(0, H - 2)) whatever the strength; nulls and the row layout are unchanged. The uncapped sim values are pso-roguelike quests/spire/data/economy.json meta_heat.H_auto (those of the sim before balans 4: newserv f93e223).
MetaHeat._comment: v54: one table per ladder rung. HAuto is Normal (q920-q922 and every quest outside the ladder); HAutoHard, HAutoVHard and HAutoUltimate are the tables of q981/q984, q982/q985 and q983/q986 (newserv spire_meta_ladder_quest_rung), from pso-roguelike spike/balans 9747023 (C3: bosses on the entry level, heat search at the entry level) quests/spire/data/economy-<rung>.json meta_heat (the same meta_heat_for on sim/plan-spire-<rung>.json, with the rung's DFP rows and HTD band), not capped, P 0-16, the catalogue's highest strength. The rung's Run I quest (q981-q983) carries heat rows H 0..H_max of its rung (Hard 4; Very Hard and Ultimate 0 since balans 4: every cell is 0, so no heat rows, no heat patch and H 0) as its heat patch; Run II (q984-q986) has no override room and plays H 0. A rung without its table plays H 0.
